add_repo_folder_hint: Pick a folder that holds a Git repository.
add_repo_gitlab_unexpected: Unexpected answer from the GitLab server
add_repo_search_github: Search your repositories and your organisations'
add_repo_signed_out: No account connected: only public repositories are listed.
branches_archive_confirm: Tag the tip of {branch} under archive/? The branch itself stays.
branches_changed_outside: The repository changed outside GitSpace after this was shown, so nothing was done. Check the branches and try again.
branches_checkout_failed: Could not check out the branch
branches_conflicts_detail: Resolve them in the Changes tab: {files}
branches_delete_unmerged: Delete {branch}? It is not merged into {current}, so its own commits will be on no branch.
branches_no_own_commits: Every commit of {branch} is already on {current}.
branches_note_merge: Merge: {current} gets the commits of {branch} ({count}) in a new merge commit. You confirm before it runs.
branches_note_rebase: Rebase: the commits of {current} are replayed on top of {branch}, which rewrites them. You confirm before it runs.
branches_rebase_confirm: Rebase {current} onto {branch}? The commits of {current} are rewritten.
branches_select: Select a branch to see where it stands.
changes_discard_confirm: Discard the changes to {file}? This cannot be undone.
changes_no_diff: No text changes to show for this file.
changes_nothing_detail: The working tree on {branch} matches the last commit.
changes_restore_warning: Its local changes will be lost.
changes_select_file: Select a file to see its changes.
changes_template_feature_text:
feat: short summary

- describe the change
- add context or links
changes_template_fix_text:
fix: bug summary

Explain the root cause and how it was fixed.
changes_template_wip_text: WIP: describe the work in progress
changes_truncated: The diff stops here: the file is too large to show in full.
clone_stalled: Clone stopped: no data arrived for {seconds} seconds
error_config: Configuration error. Please check your settings.
error_git: Git operation failed. Please check the repository status.
error_io: File system operation failed. Verify permissions and disk space.
error_network: Network request failed. Check your connection or proxy settings.
error_validation: The provided input is not valid. Please double-check and try again.
header_no_terminal: No supported terminal emulator found on PATH
header_status_failed: Could not read the repository status
history_checkout_confirm: Check out {hash}? HEAD will be detached, so new commits will not be on any branch.
history_checkout_failed: Could not check out the commit
history_select_commit: Select a commit to see its changes.
history_select_file: Select a file to see its diff.
network_http_blocked: Plain HTTP is blocked while Prefer HTTPS is on in your network preferences.
network_https_blocked: HTTPS connections are blocked while Prefer HTTPS is off in your network preferences.
network_ssh_blocked: SSH access is blocked while Allow SSH is off in your network preferences.
prefs_about_desc: Version, licence and where GitSpace keeps its files.
prefs_accounts_desc: Tokens are kept in the system keyring and only sent to their own host.
prefs_allow_ssh_desc: Off: remotes with an SSH URL are refused.
prefs_client_ids_built_in: This build has a client ID built in (GITSPACE_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID or GITSPACE_GITLAB_CLIENT_ID), used instead of the one typed here.
prefs_client_ids_desc: Register an OAuth app with the provider and enter its client ID. GitHub: tick “Enable Device Flow”; the callback URL is not used. GitLab: untick “Confidential” and set the redirect URI to http://127.0.0.1:9876/callback.
prefs_connection_desc: The transfer timeout and the protocols GitSpace may use.
prefs_default_folder_desc: New repositories are cloned here. Press Enter to apply a typed path.
prefs_encrypted_fallback_desc: Also saves tokens in an encrypted file. Off: a token is only saved when the system keyring works.
prefs_fetch_desc: Fetches the remote of the open repository on a timer.
prefs_file_desc: Copy your preferences to another computer, or go back to the defaults.
prefs_git_desc: Where to clone, and when to look for new commits.
prefs_github_desc: GitHub shows a code to enter on its sign-in page.
prefs_github_waiting: Waiting for you to approve on GitHub…
prefs_gitlab_desc: GitLab opens a browser window to sign in.
prefs_idle_timeout_desc: Seconds without data before a transfer stops.
prefs_language_desc: Applies at once to every screen.
prefs_language_row_desc: System follows the language of your session.
prefs_logs_desc: GitSpace writes one log file per day.
prefs_logs_kept_desc: Older files are deleted at the next start.
prefs_no_client_id: Enter an OAuth client ID first, under OAuth app client IDs.
prefs_pinned_desc: Pinned branches stay at the top of the Branches tab.
prefs_pinned_none: No pinned branch. Pin one from the Branches tab.
prefs_prefer_https_desc: On: plain http:// remotes are refused. Off: https:// remotes are refused.
prefs_proxy_desc: Leave a field empty to connect directly.
prefs_reopen_last: Reopen the last repository at startup
prefs_reopen_last_desc: Off: GitSpace starts on the Add repository screen.
prefs_reset_confirm: Reset every preference to its default? This cannot be undone.
prefs_scan_folder: List the repositories in this folder
prefs_scan_folder_desc: Adds each repository one level down to the sidebar.
prefs_startup_desc: What GitSpace shows when it starts.
prefs_storage_desc: Where tokens are saved when the system keyring cannot hold them.
prefs_token_desc: A personal access token, for self-hosted servers or when OAuth is not available.
prefs_token_empty: Enter a host and a token.
remote_pull_diverged: Non-fast-forward pull required. Please merge or rebase manually.
remote_pull_not_checked_out: Pull only updates the checked-out branch, and {branch} is not checked out.
remote_push_not_checked_out: Push only sends the checked-out branch, and {branch} is not checked out.
repo_missing_detail: {path} is missing or is not a Git repository.
startup_migration_failed: Could not move your settings to the new folder
startup_migration_failed_detail: GitSpace is using the old folder for now. {error}
stashes_applied_not_dropped: The stash was applied but not dropped: {error}
stashes_apply_drop_failed: Could not apply and drop the stash
stashes_conflicts_kept: The apply left conflicts, so the stash was kept. Resolve them, then drop the stash.
stashes_drop_confirm: Drop stash #{index} “{message}”? This cannot be undone.
stashes_empty_detail: Stashed changes are listed here until you apply or drop them.
stashes_select_file: Choose a file to see its changes.
stashes_will_stash_many: {count} changed files will be stashed and the working copy becomes clean.
stashes_will_stash_one: 1 changed file will be stashed and the working copy becomes clean.
token_host_not_https: The host must use https: GitSpace never sends a token over plain HTTP.
